preregistration.operator: User approved playback and U8c/U6b execution; Codex source3 new-account continuation

privacy.redaction_boundary: All prompts, provider receipts, databases, IDs, account fingerprint, auth expiry and host paths are withheld-private pending exact-byte review; key contents are never persisted; actual charges stay unknown.

comparison.comparator: A-Choice: Astra V1; B-Choice: jev-1.13.0; injected c1m0/c0m1/c1m1; paired concurrent slots

environment.reset_strategy: Fresh public-network agent container and separate no-network verifier per trial; paired concurrent slot (all arms launched together, next slot only after every arm is cleaned up); no operator workspace mount; root 180s/6 rounds, agent 210s, setup 600s, verifier 30s, watchdog 930s, cleanup 120s; panel and E2E never overlap; account fp anonymous-account-03/pro shared with a user-approved video session (external usage unknown).

study.analysis_plan: 05 v2.2 §3 (definitions, cluster bootstrap 2,000, seed from split manifest), §3.5 reliability (U7 only), §3.6 within-pair latency interpretation, §1.5 design-leak rules. selection-freeze sha256: n/a. Workload order per 05 v2.2 §8.1.
study.decision_rule: Descriptive (mixed); per-cell recovery, first misjudgment, repair depth, usage and time.
study.invalidation_rule: Judgment-output invalid is a semantic failure of a valid trial and keeps the trial in its denominator. Infrastructure invalid (transport failure, route drift, missing or contradictory usage, observation-check failure, incomplete export) is validity=invalid, outcome=unknown with a failure class; the first such cell stops dispatch, it stays selected and the primary is reported as not measurable. There is no replacement. A Jev failure followed by an LLM decision never counts as Jev acceptance.

primary_metric.aggregation: (Jev recovered - Astra recovered) / 18 task-cells (c1m0,c0m1,c1m1 x 6 tasks)
primary_metric.name: m8i_choice_recovery_delta

study.research_gap: Earlier cohorts used label-only verdicts, three authored tasks and serial arms; calibration, reliability and load-matched comparison were not measured.
study.research_question: After an injected defect, does the Choice verdict engine change recovery to an oracle-passing answer?
